testcase.name: Composition with M2: easing a TimingSample progress keeps [0, 1] and the ends (section 6, DM3-13)
Continuity: IN_OUT easings join at 1/2; smoothstep/smootherstep have zero slope at both ends (C1/C2 ends) (section 6)
Range and accuracy fuzz: 0 <= f <= 1 and |f - exact| <= 2^-50 against an exact rational evaluation (section 6)
Power easings are exactly monotone on doubles; smoothstep and smootherstep are monotone up to 2^-49 (section 6, DM3-11)
Symmetry f(1 - t) = 1 - f(t) for symmetric easings and duality OUT(t) = 1 - IN(1 - t), to 2^-49 (section 6)
Endpoints and clamping: f(t) = 0 for t <= 0 (including -0.0 and -infinity), 1 for t >= 1 (including +infinity); NaN is rejected (section 6)
Exactly the 15 specified easings exist, in the specified order (section 6)
